headline: Public hearing on Residential Tax Exemption and Minimum Residential Factor for Fiscal Year 2027.
summary: The City Council will hold a public hearing to adopt a Residential Tax Exemption and Minimum Residential Factor for Fiscal Year 2027.
items: Public hearing on adopting a Residential Tax Exemption for Fiscal Year 2027
Public hearing on adopting a Minimum Residential Factor for Fiscal Year 2027
location: Herbert L. Jackson City Council Chambers, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA
plain_text:
MALDEN CITY COUNCIL 
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING 
 
 
 
A Public Hearing will be held by the Malden City Council at Malden 
City Hall in the Herbert L. Jackson City Council Chambers located 
at 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA on October 27, 2026 at 7:00 
P.M.  The purpose of this meeting is to adopt a Residential  Tax 
Exemption and Minimum Residential Factor for Fiscal Year 2027.  
 
If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please 
contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at 
mluise@cityofmalden.org  or 781-397-7000, Ext 2005.  
 
 
 
 
 
Amanda Linehan, President 
Malden City Council  
October 15, 2026
